lines.beaver: 민준 학생, 이번 시험 성적이 많이 올랐네요.
lines.beaver_en: Minjun, your grades went up a lot on this exam.
lines.beaver_roman: Minjun haksaeng, ibeon siheom seongjeogi mani ollanneyo.
lines.en: Yes, I made it into the top ranks for the first time.

lines.beaver: 축하해요. 어느 영역이 제일 많이 올랐어요?
lines.beaver_en: Congratulations. Which area improved the most?
lines.beaver_roman: Chukahaeyo. Eoneu yeongyeogi jeil mani ollasseoyo?
lines.learner: 국어요. 긴 지문을 빨리 읽는 법을 터득했어요.
lines.en: Korean. I mastered how to read long passages quickly.
lines.roman: Gugeoyo. Gin jimuneul ppalli ingneun beobeul teodeukaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How did you learn that method?
lines.learner: 선생님께서 알려 주신 덕분에 방법이 바뀌었어요.
lines.en: Thanks to what you taught me, my method changed.
lines.roman: Seonsaengnimkkeseo allyeo jusin deokbune bangbeobi bakkwieosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. But your math score dropped a little.
lines.learner: 네, 심화 문제가 많이 출제돼서 어려웠어요.
lines.en: Yes, many advanced questions were set, so it was hard.
lines.roman: Ne, simhwa munjega mani chuljedwaeseo eoryeowosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Did you memorize the formulas well?
lines.learner: 암기력은 좋은데 응용이 약한 것 같아요.
lines.en: My memorization is good, but I think I'm weak at applying it.
lines.roman: Amgiryeogeun joeunde eungyongi yakan geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: Were you busy with other subjects, by any chance?
lines.learner: 네, 예체능 실기 연습으로 시간이 부족했어요.
lines.en: Yes, arts and PE practice left me short on time.
lines.roman: Ne, yechenung silgi yeonseubeuro sigani bujokaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then do you have a plan for math?
lines.learner: 단계적으로 쉬운 문제부터 다시 풀 거예요.
lines.en: I'll redo problems step by step, starting with easy ones.
lines.roman: Dangyejeogeuro swiun munjebuteo dasi pul kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋은 계획이에요. 다음 달에 성취도 평가도 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Good plan. There's also an achievement test next month.
lines.beaver_roman: Joeun gyehoegieyo. Daeum dare seongchwido pyeonggado isseoyo.
lines.learner: 성적에 반영은 안 되지만 열심히 할게요.
lines.en: It doesn't count toward my grades, but I'll work hard.
lines.roman: Seongjeoge banyeongeun an doejiman yeolsimhi halkkeyo.

lines.beaver: 다음 학기 반 배정 방식은 알고 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Do you know how classes are assigned next semester?
lines.beaver_roman: Daeum hakgi ban baejeong bangsigeun algo isseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, I heard they're decided by grade order.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 지금처럼 하면 될 거예요. 힘내요.
lines.beaver_en: That's right. Keep it up like now and you'll be fine. Cheer up.
lines.beaver_roman: Majayo. Jigeumcheoreom hamyeon doel kkeoyeyo. Himnaeyo.
lines.en: Thank you, teacher. I'll definitely stay in the top ranks.
